d:
Mrityunjay Tiwari On Tejashwi Yadav : nitish setu ke udghatan ke bad bihar ki siyasat garma gaee hai. is mudde par mrityunjay tivari ne neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav par aarop lagaya ki tejasvi yadav ko vikas karyon se jalan ho rahi hai. unhonne kaha ki karib 34 hajar karor rupye ki pariyojnaon ki saugat bihar ko mili hai aur nitish setu se raghopur ki janta ko bhi phayda hoga.
